authority: Coordinator technical default under the AGENTS.md Owner Process Constraints, logged in docs/decision_log.md. It repairs review round 1 findings A1-M5-01 (execution at the signal's own close) and A2-M1 (years_since_publication carries future publication information). It tightens R1 and R6 and loosens none of R1, R2, R4, R6, R8, or R9. The v1 amendment_policy lists only R2 to R4 and the step 3 tests, so this amendment is recorded as a coordinator default outside that list, as amendment 1 was.

problem.A1-M5-01: v1 forms month t's weights from returns through month t-1, whose last observation is the close of month t-1, and earns the whole month-t return from that same close. A signal known only after a close cannot be executed at that close.
problem.A2-M1: v1 defines years_since_publication as year(t) minus the publication year, which is negative before publication. Only hindsight reveals that a factor will be published, so the negative values tell R4 which factors are still to be published.
problem.month_t_availability: v1 admits factor i to month t only if its month-t return exists. Under the corrected order that return is not known at decision time, and removing a member for a missing holding-month return reallocates its weight (review advisories A1-M5-02 and A2-A4).

timing.label: after_month_end_signal_next_month_end_execution
timing.event_order: For return month t: the signal month is t-2 and the feature observation end is the close of the last trading day of month t-2; signal availability and decision are strictly after that close; the execution (target reset and switch cost) is the close of the last trading day of month t-1, the next observed close on the monthly observation grid; the target first earns the month-t return, from the close of month t-1 to the close of month t. The month t-1 return is earned by the previous target.
timing.rule: Every input to month t's set, weights, states, and traits uses observations through month t-2 only. The switch cost recorded at the execution close is deducted from the month-t return, as in v1.
timing.first_month: The 1972-01 target executes at the 1971-12 close from no holdings, so 1972-01 turnover is 1 as in v1.
timing.relation_to_repository_contract: after_close_signal_next_observed_close_v1 on a monthly observation grid with a signal lag of one observed row: signal row month t-2, execution row month t-1, first return row month t.
timing.required_test: On a synthetic fixture: changing any return in months t-1 and later, including a finite-to-missing change, leaves the set, sigma, weights, states, and traits for month t unchanged; changing a month t-2 return can change month t's sigma; a set member whose month-t return is missing refuses the run.

change.window_shift: Every window in v1 that ends at month t-1 ends at month t-2 instead, with its length unchanged: R1 sigma and membership use months t-37 to t-2; R3 and trailing_12m_return use months t-13 to t-2; market_trend uses months t-13 to t-2; market_volatility uses the 63 trading days ending on the last trading day of month t-2 and the expanding median through month t-2; credit_spread uses the value for month t-3, one month behind the signal month, against the median of months t-122 to t-3.
change.membership_rule: Factor i enters the set for month t only if it has at least 24 non-missing monthly returns in months t-37 to t-2 and none of those 36 months carries a bad-data code (blank_field or provider_missing_code). A month typed absent (no provider row) counts only against the 24-return condition. The v1 condition that factor i has a month-t return is removed. A set member whose month-t return is missing refuses that universe's run; nothing is reallocated. The report counts factor-months excluded for short history and for bad data in the lookback.
change.return_availability_note: Replaced by the membership rule above; month-t return availability is not a set condition.
change.R4: R4's target for features at signal month t-2 is the month-t return. A refit for month t uses only (feature, return) pairs whose return month is t-2 or earlier. The v2 amendment fixes how R4 weights a factor-month that has no forecast.

years_since_publication.definition: calendar year of the signal month t-2 minus the publication year from jkp_factor_details, defined only when that difference is positive; jkp_factors_153 only
years_since_publication.not_yet_published: for year(t-2) at or before the publication year the trait is typed missing (not_yet_published), the factor-month leaves R4's training and forecasting inputs, and the count is reported under R6
years_since_publication.missing_publication_year: unchanged: the 11 v1 factors keep a typed missing value and are counted
years_since_publication.required_test: changing a factor's publication year from one year to another, both at or after year(t-2), leaves the trait for month t and every earlier month unchanged; when R4 exists, the same change leaves every R4 input and weight for month t unchanged

change.post_publication_months: For month t, the post-publication subset is the month's set restricted to factors whose publication year is before the calendar year of the signal month t-2, that is the factor-months with a defined years_since_publication. Amendment 1's start-month rule applies unchanged.
change.unchanged: Data sources, universes and their members, the evaluation window and halves, R0, R1's weight formula, R2, costs and turnover, step 2 metrics, step 2 tests, the step 2 decision rule, and every other v1 and amendment 1 section.
